Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.gwc

Interface GwcTruncateRequest

All Known Implementing Classes:
GwcTruncateExtentRequest, GwcTruncateLayerRequest, GwcTruncateOrphansRequest, GwcTruncateParametersRequest
public interface GwcTruncateRequest
Marker interface for POST /gwc/rest/masstruncate request bodies. GWC truncate requests are XML-serialized; each subtype maps to a different XML root element. Implementations: GwcTruncateLayerRequest, GwcTruncateParametersRequest, GwcTruncateOrphansRequest, GwcTruncateExtentRequest.
